Usage: simdbench [-group addition|computation|all] [-addition] [-computation]

Benchmarks scalar and SIMD operations on a fixed 1,048,576-element input.
  -addition
    	alias for -group addition
  -computation
    	alias for -group computation
  -function string
    	deprecated alias: add, compute, or all
  -group string
    	benchmark group: addition, computation, or all
